rule: Every fulfilled order has exactly one fulfill-order row (its fulfillment's, with the settlement's amount and entry) and every completed operation one confirm-operation row (its first succeeded payment's); nothing else is enqueued; a done row has its receipt or confirmation, valid under the lab's key and carrying the row's fields; no effect is written twice, also when the worker is killed at any point; after the last pass every row is done.
message: row op0:op0/i0 is done but its effect file is absent
note: An operation completes and the payer's outbox worker dies holding its confirm-operation row; on the mutant the next pass acknowledges the row without writing the confirmation, so a done row has no effect file.
